name: Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling, Inc.
old_description: Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling was founded in 2009 with the aspiration to become the Premier plastic injection molding supplier in the Southeast.  The owners of Premier Plastic, Scott Dittman and Phillip Sparks, came together bringing their combined experiences in injection molding to form a plastic manufacturing company with a focus on quality and service.  We are always committed to promoting our outstanding reputation by treating our customers with integrity and excellence.
about:
Plastic Molding & Tooling, Inc. was founded in 2009 in Winder, Georgia, just northeast of Atlanta. The company was formed by Scott Dittman and Phillip Sparks, who combined their experience in injection molding to establish a plastic manufacturing business focused on quality and service.

The shop specializes in custom injection molding, tooling, and product development, offering prototyping assistance to help entrepreneurs and inventors move from concept to production. It also runs stocking programs designed to keep molded parts available on demand and emphasizes quick turnaround on orders.

The company serves entrepreneurs, inventors, and other customers across the Southeast seeking a local source for custom-molded plastic components. It works with clients regardless of order volume, providing personalized service from prototype through full-scale manufacturing.

The founders' stated aspiration was to become the injection molding supplier in the Southeast, differentiating through integrity, excellence, and an American-owned, operated model that prioritizes direct customer relationships.

old_description: Gehen Sie auf Entdeckungsreise und lernen Sie auf einzigartige Weise unsere PRETTLworld kennen! about:
Prettl Automotive is headquartered in Greenville, South Carolina. The company traces its roots to 1953 when Franz W. Prettl founded the PRETTL Group in Germany. Now in its third generation of family ownership, the business is led by Willi and Johannes Prettl, sons of the second-generation leaders Erhardt and Rolf Prettl.

The group’s automotive division focuses on electronics, metal components, and charging systems. Its portfolio includes energy management systems, mobile connectivity solutions for vehicles, and DC-DC charging technology. The company holds certifications including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 14001, and IATF 16949, reflecting its quality, medical device, environmental, and automotive standards.

Prettl serves the automotive industry, supplying components for electrification and connectivity. Its customer base includes automotive OEMs and tier-one suppliers requiring energy management, radio frequency systems, and charging infrastructure. The group’s international footprint allows it to support clients across continents.

The company emphasizes a culture of “Eco-Preneurship,” combining long-term family values with a drive to pioneer future business fields such as sustainability and employee empowerment. This philosophy, rooted in the founder’s motto of “the entrepreneur in the company,” aims to give staff the freedom to act as intrapreneurs.

Prima Distribution was incorporated out of the need in the Midwest for a high-quality distributor designed to meet the unique requirements and demands of the theatre and concession industry. Since its inception over two decades ago, Prima has earned a reputation for excellent service and competitive pricing. about:
Prima Distribution Inc. operates from Omaha, Nebraska, where it was incorporated over two decades ago to address the lack of a high-quality distributor for the theatre and concession industry in the Midwest. The company entered the market with a focus on the unique requirements of concession operators, building a reputation for reliable service and competitive pricing.

As the self-described largest distributor of concession foods and equipment in the Midwest, Prima supplies a range of products from its Omaha facility. The company serves customers across Nebraska, throughout Iowa, portions of South Dakota, and the greater St. Louis region. Its staff consists entirely of food-service professionals who bring an average of more than 25 years of industry experience to each transaction.

Prima’s customer base includes movie theatres, entertainment venues, and concession stands throughout its delivery footprint. The company provides both food products and the equipment needed to prepare and serve them, positioning itself as a single-source partner for concession operators in the region.

The business was founded specifically to fill a gap in the Midwest for a distributor that understood the particular demands of theatre and concession operations. That origin story, combined with a team of long-tenured industry veterans, is cited as the foundation for the company’s service-first approach.

name: Pristine Surgical
old_description: “The Summit arthroscope performed exceptionally well, and the procedure went according to plan,” said Dr. Mark Getelman, who specializes in arthroscopic and minimally invasive reconstructive surgery of the shoulder and knee at SCOI and is past president of the Arthroscopy Association of North America (AANA). “The ability to get a new 4K scope for every procedure while improving our workflow makes Summit an exciting product for our operating room. We’re proud to have performed this procedure at SCOI where surgical innovation has been a hallmark of our practice since our founding.”
about:
Pristine Surgical operates from Manchester, New Hampshire, as a medical device company founded to simplify endoscopy. The company combines single-use endoscopes with cloud-based software to make minimally invasive visualization more efficient, consistent, and safe. While the founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the board includes representatives from Piney Lake Capital Management and former Medtronic executives.

The company's flagship product, Summit™, is a first-of-its-kind 4K single-use surgical arthroscope delivered through a "Scopes as a Subscription™" model with transparent pricing and automated inventory management. All systems come pre-installed with Pristine Connect®, a cloud-based platform that handles inventory, image and video sharing, and digital training checklists. Pristine Surgical is developing a full portfolio of rigid and flexible endoscopes spanning arthroscopy, laparoscopy, and flexible endoscopy, addressing a market of approximately 125 million procedures worldwide each year.

The company serves hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and orthopedic surgeons specializing in sports medicine. Clinical users include Southern California Orthopedic Institute, UCLA, Hospital for Special Surgery in New York, Virtua Health in New Jersey, Doral Surgery Center in Florida, and Stetson Lee Orthopaedics in California. The medical advisory board features prominent orthopedic surgeons such as Mark Getelman, MD, David McAllister, MD, Stephen Snyder, MD, and Riley Williams III, MD.

Pristine Surgical was started to remove inefficiency, variability, and safety issues from the endoscopy suite. Conventional reusable systems require costly maintenance contracts, sterilization services, and repairs, while dirty or damaged scopes disrupt workflow and present safety risks. The single-use platform eliminates cleaning and maintenance, reduces operating room setup and teardown time, and provides a new high-definition image for every procedure.

name: Pro Form Metals
old_description: "The Pro Form Metals team was easy to work with, friendly, and they have done great work on my custom fabrication jobs. They get my projects done on time and are easy to communicate with regarding my project needs and the fabrication schedule."
about:
Pro Form Metals operates a fabrication shop on Dickerson Road in Reno, Nevada. The family-owned business is led by Keith Goguen and serves Northern Nevada and the Lake Tahoe region.

The shop produces custom architectural metalwork including chimney caps, fireplace surrounds, seamless gutters, kitchen range hoods, railings, gates, flashing, and trim. Work ranges from one-off pieces to production runs, all welded and formed in-house. The company also supplies cut-to-length metal roofing panels and sources flat sheet, coil, and structural steel from Metal Sales, AEP Span, Taylor Metals, Western States Metal Roofing, Pacific Steel, and PDM Steel. No roof installation is offered.

Customers include builders, contractors, and homeowners across Reno, Sparks, Truckee, Carson City, Dayton, Fernley, Incline Village, Lake Tahoe, and Minden-Gardnerville. Projects span residential and commercial construction, with an emphasis on Sierra weather resistance.

The company emphasizes local fabrication—every piece is built in its Reno shop—and materials-only supply for roofing, distinguishing it from full-service installers.

name: Pro Shaper Sheet Metal LLC
old_description: Our shop handles TIG, MIG, and specialty welding for steel, stainless, aluminum, and more. From repair work to fully custom fabrication, we take on projects that require precision, strength, and practical problem solving.
about:
Pro Shaper Sheet Metal LLC operates from Charlton, Massachusetts. The business traces its lineage to a restoration shop started in the 1960s by Ted Billings in Worcester, where his grandson Wray grew up learning metalworking on classic Auburns and Chris-Craft boats. Wray now leads the company, which evolved from that family tradition into a dedicated metal-shaping resource.

The shop provides TIG, MIG, and specialty welding on steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, along with full custom fabrication and coachbuilding services. It also runs hands-on classes covering wheeling, planishing, shrinking, stretching, and panel development. In addition, Pro Shaper designs and sells professional-grade shaping tools — including shrinking discs, mallet sets with Delrin heads, lead-shot dollies, and shaping kits — curated for serious fabricators.

Customers range from classic-car restorers and Auburn/Cord/Duesenberg club members to fabricators developing one-off concepts and hobbyists building their skills. The company’s coachbuilding work emphasizes period correctness with modern durability, while its classes and tools serve both professional shops and individual builders.

Pro Shaper positions itself as a bridge between old-world coachbuilding discipline and today’s fabrication demands. The team builds and sources tools that “earn their place on the bench” and teaches users to maximize each pass, guided by the principle that “control, patience, and the right tool — that is how great shapes happen.”

name: Progressive Industrial Electrical
old_description: Progressive Industrial Electrical, Inc (P-I-E) is full service industrial electrical contractor and UL 508A panel shop.  We have been locally owned and operated since 2008.  Our company was founded on the principle that strong customer relationships are formed by offering high quality services at fair prices, emphasizing integrity and transparency.
about:
Progressive Industrial Electrical, Inc. (P-I-E) was established in 2008 in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company has been locally owned and operated since its inception, founded on the principle that strong customer relationships are built through high-quality services at fair prices, with an emphasis on integrity and transparency.

The firm operates as a full-service industrial electrical contractor and a UL 508A-listed panel shop. Its service portfolio spans high-, medium-, and low-voltage power distribution, including pole setting, overhead line work, switchgear and transformer installation, motor control center (MCC) and variable frequency drive (VFD) installation and commissioning. In-house capabilities extend to electrical design using AutoCAD Electrical, PLC and SCADA system design, programming, and upgrades, HMI programming, instrument installation and calibration, and industrial communications such as fiber and copper Ethernet and network configuration.

P-I-E serves industrial clients across sectors that require electrical infrastructure, control systems, and automation solutions, though the company does not publicly list specific industry verticals or named customers.

P-I-E was founded on the principle that strong customer relationships are formed by offering high-quality services at fair prices, emphasizing integrity and transparency. A stated differentiator is the company's in-house SCADA and controls capabilities, which it notes sets it apart from other contractors.

name: Pronghorn Pump LLC.
old_description: Pronghorn Pump specializes in designing remote water systems based on each customers unique and individual needs. No two users are alike and neither are our systems. Built to your exact demands, we will help you meet your remote water pumping needs.
about:
Pronghorn Pump LLC was founded in 1996 in Evansville, Wyoming, by Scott Blakeley, a certified pump installer who serves as the company’s owner. The business began as a statewide service and installation operation focused on solar-powered pumping units for remote locations.

The company designs custom remote water systems tailored to each customer’s unique requirements, specializing in solar pumping units. Its services also include water sampling, well testing, and groundwater monitoring, all supported by statewide installation and ongoing maintenance.

Pronghorn Pump serves customers needing off-grid water solutions, including agricultural, ranching, and residential clients across Wyoming. The firm emphasizes that no two systems are alike, building each to the exact demands of the end user.

Blakeley’s operation distinguishes itself through a commitment to quality, availability, service, and value, with the owner’s certification underscoring technical credibility. The company pledges to service every installation with the same pride shown during the initial build, maintaining a “we service what we sell” philosophy.

name: Provisur Technologies
old_description: Produce high quality applications that hit all the industry trends — cleanly and efficiently. Our portfolio of leading food processing machine brands and decades of food science and sales experience help your business win in growing food markets.
about:
Provisur Technologies is headquartered in Mokena, Illinois. The company operates as a global manufacturer of food processing equipment, drawing on decades of food science and sales experience. While a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed, the business has built a portfolio of established brands that serve protein processors worldwide.

The company designs and builds equipment for separation, grinding, forming, slicing, cooking, defrosting, and marinating. Key product lines include Weiler mixer grinders, Formax formers, Beehive separators, and Lutetia defrosting tumblers. Provisur runs two Ingenuity Centers where customers can test applications on full-scale machinery. A global staff of food processing professionals provides parts and service support. The company employs approximately 3,000 people.

Provisur serves the food processing industry, with a focus on meat, poultry, seafood, and prepared foods manufacturers. Its equipment produces items such as burgers, pork patties, chicken nuggets, patties and fries, meatballs, and fish sticks. Customers range from large-scale protein processors to companies developing new formed and sliced products.

Provisur emphasizes innovation, customization, and high performance to deliver quality control, throughput, flexibility, and hygiene. The company says its brand portfolio and application expertise help customers win in growing food markets.

name: Prysmian Group USA
old_description: Prysmian Group is a global cable manufacturer. In the U.S., produces power and specialty cables for electrical utilities, telecom and industrial applications. Operates manufacturing facilities in Texas among other states.
about:
Prysmian Group USA is headquartered in Houston, Texas. The U.S. entity was established in 2005 as part of the global Prysmian Group, which traces its roots back 150 years. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Texas and other states.

The company produces power cables, data cables, and telecommunication cables for electrical utilities, telecom, and industrial applications. Its U.S. operations employ over 15,000 people across multiple facilities. The product portfolio includes low-carbon aluminum cables designed to reduce the carbon footprint of AI infrastructure and hollow-core fiber for AI-ready data centers.

Prysmian serves utilities, oil and gas, telecommunications, and data center industries. Its customers include electrical utilities, telecom operators, and industrial firms. The company has recently expanded its submarine telecom capabilities through the acquisition of Xtera and deepened its strategic partnership with Aurubis.

Prysmian emphasizes local production in the United States, with leadership stating that the U.S. values local production. The company differentiates itself through low-carbon cable innovations and a global footprint spanning over 50 countries.
